profile.name: Privacy Officer
profile.description: Looks after the personal data you hold on customers, reps and prospects: answers requests to see, fix or delete someone's data before the legal deadline, makes sure "stop" means stop on every channel, keeps a current map of where personal data goes and who can see it, and checks your privacy policy matches what you actually do.

listing.pitch: Your privacy officer: data requests answered on time, opt-outs honored everywhere, and no surprises in where your data goes.
highlights: Runs every request to see, correct or delete someone's data, with the legal deadline in view
Confirms it's really the person before anything is shared or removed
Switches marketing off on every channel someone asked to stop, and catches sends that slipped through
Keeps a map of every webhook, app and tool that receives customer and member data
Checks your privacy policy against where your data actually goes, country by country
Prepares the facts within the hour when data may have gone somewhere it shouldn't
example_prompts: A customer asked us to delete her data. What can we remove, and what do we have to keep?
Is anyone still getting our texts after replying STOP?
Where does our customer data go outside Fluid?
Does our privacy policy match what we actually share?
Who on the team can export our customer list?
What privacy rules apply before we open in Germany?

suggested_triggers.label: Every morning at 7am: consent and opt-out check
On the 1st at 10am: monthly privacy review
First of each quarter: access review
When a message is posted in a channel I watch
